headline: NFP +165K, hike odds 78%, Nikkei +3.5%, Nvidia -5% pre-mkt, WTI $89.70, 3y auction 1pm
stance: Payrolls locked December; the selloff is now a credit and supply story. Asia bounced 2-6% Monday, Nasdaq 100 futures flat pre-market: the rebound has not crossed the Pacific.

news.head: Nvidia -5.2% pre-market (~4:25am ET) on board probe of Huang
news.body: Independent directors review reports Huang was targeted by Chinese intelligence; Huang admits the affair, stays CEO. Trump backs him. Friday close $186.64.

news.head: CoreWeave reports Tuesday; 5y CDS 1,155bp Friday
news.body: From a 1,289bp record Thursday. 2032 notes yield above 16%; Q2 interest expense $640mn, Q3 guided $860-940mn. Stock -50% in a month.

news.head: UniCredit Q3 profit +24%, FY guide up; +3.6% (~3:10am ET)
news.body: Credit Agricole proposes merging its Italian unit with Banco BPM to form Italy's third-largest bank; BPM +9.4%, Credit Agricole -1.4%.

news.head: LVMH -3%, Burberry -2% Monday on weak China October data
news.body: Luxury led the CAC 40 lower (-0.1%, ~3:30am ET) while the Stoxx 600 rose. The China consumer read-through, not AI, is Europe's Monday laggard.

implications: Payrolls removed the pause-on-the-selloff option: 78% hike odds with the Nasdaq 100 -5% on the week. CPI Tuesday is the only release left that can move December.
Credit is leading equities: HY spreads widest since April 2025, CCC near widest since 2020. The $125bn refunding and the neocloud prints land on the same three days.

watch.head: 3y auction 1pm today; $125bn refunding week
watch.body: 10y Tuesday, 30y Thursday. Cash Treasuries closed Wednesday (Veterans Day); stocks open. 10y is 50bp off last month's 5%+ peak into the supply.

watch.head: Trump meets Qatar PM, White House noon ET
watch.body: Rubio Sunday: talks "not very productive", Iranian demands "unrealistic". US struck Qeshm Island overnight; IRGC says three tankers exploded Sunday.

watch.head: CPI Tuesday Nov 10, 8:30
watch.body: First inflation print at 78% December hike odds. Shutdown gaps in the data: watch the monthly core change, not the annual rate. PPI Friday Nov 13.

watch.head: AI capex prints: SoftBank Tue, Nebius Thursday Nov 12
watch.body: Cisco and Applied Materials also report this week. SoftBank -2.9% Monday in Tokyo after Chinese regulators rejected its $5.4bn ABB robotics deal.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Payrolls +165K Friday vs 65K consensus, +84K revisions, unemployment 4.1%, hourly earnings +0.4%. December hike odds 78% (~11pm ET Sunday) from ~70% Thursday night.
WTI $89.70, -1.2% (~4:40am ET); Brent $96.76 (~2:30am ET). Trump Sunday: new strikes "highly unlikely" if talks progress. Houthi attack on Riyadh damaged an Aramco building.
DXY 102.20 (~midnight ET) after Friday's +0.8%, biggest day since June. EUR/USD 1.119 (~4am ET). Bund 10y 3.24%, -1bp, four straight weekly declines.
sections.positioning: New this week: Canadian dollar specs 85th %ile, extended long. 5y Treasury longs trimmed 5 pts w/w to 94th, 9 weeks at the extreme. Friday took back part of Thursday's rally.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: S&P futures +0.3%, Nasdaq 100 flat, Dow +0.8% (~4am ET). Nasdaq 100 -5% on the week, VIX +30% on the week.
Nikkei +3.5%, Kospi +1.8%, Taiex +6% Monday (~12:30am ET) after Taiwan's worst week in two decades. Stoxx 600 +0.5% (~4am ET), banks and tech leading.
US chipmakers slightly lower pre-market while Asian chip suppliers bounced 3-7%. The rebound is in the suppliers, not the US buyers of the chips.
sections.positioning: Nasdaq 100 longs cut 7 pts w/w to the 89th %ile. Russell 2000 99th and VIX shorts 10th unchanged, 5-6 weeks: Thursday hit full books, Friday did not empty them.

single_name.note: New to the screen Nov 6, score 5. Insider buy filed Nov 6, above its 200-day line, 4 days to cover. Test-and-measurement, outside the AI chain.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: HY spreads widest since April 2025, triple-C near widest since 2020 (Friday). The widening is in the tail, triple-C and neoclouds, not the IG index.
Hyperscaler 5y CDS up 44-76% over the month from low bases (~140-300bp). The AI debt bid is being repriced at the top of the stack, not only the neoclouds.
sections.positioning: Dealer IG inventory 44th %ile of 3 years, from 21st a week ago: dealers took paper in the selloff. No credit COT extreme.
